description: This file contains functions and types related to reasoning message parsing, extraction, and state management for a Telegram bot extension, including handling of reasoning tags and buffered answers.

methods.name: splitTelegramReasoningText
methods.description: Splits input text into reasoning and answer parts based on tags and prefixes.

methods.name: createTelegramReasoningStepState
methods.description: Creates and manages the state for reasoning steps, including buffering answers and noting hints/deliveries.
